# Quickstart playbook (generated by @flutter-bootstrap quickstart)

**Mode:** {{MODE}} · **Date:** {{DATE}}

`@flutter-bootstrap init` has already run — this file can only be written into an existing `.work.flutter/`.

## Daily loop (all modes)

```text
@flutter-session start
… work …
@flutter-verify uncommitted
@flutter-repair repair - from uncommitted    # if verify fails
@flutter-session close                      # close commit when ready
```

## Mode: lite

| Step | Command |
|------|---------|
| 1 | `@flutter-bootstrap status` — list unfilled `REPLACE:FLUTTER_*` tokens |
| 2 | Fill them in `.cursorrules` / `DOCS_FLUTTER_STACK.md`; `@flutter-stack probe` → `set` when ready |
| 3 | `@flutter-session start` |
| 4 | Edit `.work.flutter/plans/NEXT_FLUTTER.md` → one **Recommended next** row |
| 5 | Implement; run commands from `DOCS_FLUTTER_STACK.md` |
| 6 | `@flutter-verify uncommitted` → repair if needed |
| 7 | `@flutter-session close` |

Upgrade: `@flutter-foundation greenfield` when scope disputes appear.

## Mode: brownfield

| Step | Command |
|------|---------|
| 1 | `@flutter-bootstrap status` |
| 2 | `@flutter-plan-verify brownfield` |
| 3 | `@flutter-plan-repair brownfield` (optional — synthesise foundation from code) |
| 4 | `@flutter-session start` |
| 5 | `@flutter-implementation plan - F1` after HANDOFF waiver or approved master plan |
| 6 | `@flutter-implementation start` → `continue` |
| 7 | `@flutter-session close` |

## Mode: full

| Step | Command |
|------|---------|
| 1 | `@flutter-bootstrap status` — confirm the scaffold and tokens |
| 2 | `@flutter-stack probe` → `@flutter-stack set` |
| 3 | `@flutter-foundation greenfield` → `certify` |
| 4 | `@flutter-plan-master greenfield` → approve |
| 5 | `@flutter-scaffold app` |
| 6 | `@flutter-implementation plan - F1` |
| 7 | `@flutter-session start` → implement → `close` |
